visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man stands in a dimly lit indoor entryway, wearing a black t-shirt and khaki pants. He holds various small items like a phone and wallet, placing them into a black backpack with a pink tag. A patterned tapestry hangs on the wall behind him next to a wooden cabinet. (2) The scene shifts as a woman in a white tank top pulls the man back by his arm while he tries to leave. He looks startled. Variety text overlays appear around them against the neutral wall and dark door background. (3) Transition to a vibrant outdoor market scene under artificial lights. The man holds out a reusable white cloth bag to a female vendor who is placing green vegetables into it. Shelves behind her are packed with various fresh produce like carrots and onions. (4) The man is now at a cafe counter, gesturing towards a drink. He then holds up a white paper-like cup to the camera with a confused expression. The lighting is bright and even. (5) In a food stall setting, the man holds a grey collapsible silicone container. A female vendor in a black tank top looks at it with a puzzled face. Steaming pots and food displays are visible in the background. (6) A young woman with long dark hair, wearing a white tank top, speaks directly to the camera in a bright living room. A beige sofa and indoor plants are visible behind her, creating a warm, homey atmosphere. (7) Montage of the man visiting 'VGest' pizza shop and 'Unpackaged.U' store. He points to a blue 'Less Plastic' sticker on a glass door. Inside, he uses his own containers to fill bulk goods from large plastic dispensers on wooden shelves. (8) The woman from phase 6 reappears, speaking earnestly to the camera. Her facial expressions are animated and her hands move frequently to emphasize her points. The lighting remains soft and natural. (9) The final scene shows the man in the market again, eating from his reusable container with chopsticks. He appears to be reacting to spicy food, squinting his eyes and opening his mouth in a comic 'hot' expression.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) Fast-paced acoustic guitar music starts with a rhythmic beat. A male voice chants items quickly like a mantra. A 'click' SFX triggers as items are packed. (2) A sharp 'whoosh' SFX accompanies a shift in tone as a female voice shouts 'And your wife!'. Comic 'ding' sounds are heard. (3) The audio switches to a field recording of a bustling market. The man speaks in a friendly, high-pitched tone to a vendor who responds with loud, enthusiastic chatter. A 'rustle' SFX occurs as items move. (4) Transition with a 'pop' SFX to a cafe. The man's voice is slightly muffled, followed by a comic 'boing' sound indicating confusion. (5) SFX of a container unfolding. Male and female voices engage in a rapid, slightly exaggerated dialogue with rising intonations. (6) A clean studio-style narration by a female speaker begins. Her voice is calm, clear, and professional. The BGM continues at a lower volume. (7) Multiple 'whoosh' and 'pop' SFX occur rapidly during a montage. Short snippets of the man's excited voice are layered over the narrator. (8) Final phase features a loud 'slurp' and 'ah' SFX as the man eats. A comedic 'horn' sound marks his spicy reaction, followed by the female narrator giving a final CTA.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Montage -> List-based -> Storytelling -> CTA: The video begins with humorous skits showing 'eco-friendly' habits, followed by the narrator explaining the 'Less Plastic More Life' store criteria, visiting specific stores as evidence, and ending with a call to visit the government website.
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To promote the 'Less Plastic More Life' (不塑之客) friendly store initiative by the New Taipei City Environmental Protection Bureau, encouraging citizens to reduce plastic waste by using their own containers and supporting certified businesses.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Direct mention of the government bureau and its logo, along with specific store visits and call-to-action to their website.
